description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege.
When Rograkh enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sakashima's Protege
uses.cardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound
